title: Deploy shared stacks from the release pipeline instead of hand-run change sets
description: Ryan, 2026-11-04, on papyrus-monitoring change sets: 'why are you manually creating change sets? Wouldn't that be a commit that we push through DevOps?' Today AGENTS.md says shared stacks are hand-run with a change set. Standing rule: public repos run Actions CI, then OIDC-triggered AWS CD, and merges to main deploy. Build it: a release to main builds and uploads the router and operator zips, then deploys papyrus-monitoring and the other shared stacks with GitHub OIDC, using a narrow role. A rollback-failed stack and an unexpected replacement must stop and alert. A dry run prints the change set on the PR.
